paragraphs: If your Defender is a classic 90, 110 or 130 with the 300Tdi diesel — the 2.5-litre four-cylinder that replaced the 200Tdi — cylinder head cracking is a well-documented issue on this engine, along with cooling system neglect and a critical timing belt interval. We replace the timing belt, inspect and pressure-test the cylinder head, and service the cooling system as standard on every 300Tdi rebuild.

The classic Defender's earlier 200Tdi shares a similar pattern, as does the later Td5 — but the 300Tdi is the engine most commonly associated with cylinder head cracking in the 2.5-litre diesel family.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, per VRF-landrover-defender.md. 200Tdi and Td5 also flagged separately in the VRF
